# ParallelCoordinateChartElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasParallelCoordinateChartElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasParallelCoordinateChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasParallelCoordinateChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasParallelCoordinateChart.h"`

Many measures per item: radar, or parallel coordinates

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasParallelCoordinateChartElement> CreateParallelCoordinateChartElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);   // Factory helper, matching the framework convention.
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasParallelCoordinateChartElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onBrushChanged` | `std::function<void(size_t passingCount)> onBrushChanged` | _Brush changed_ |
| `onRecordClick` | `std::function<void(int recordIndex)> onRecordClick` | _Record click_ |
| `onAxisOrderChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>& order)> onAxisOrderChanged` | _Axis order changed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
